comments.value:
This setting would be especially useful for desktop, would allow my mirror to always stay affixed to a specific spot on my screen when locked to local space.
https://files.catbox.moe/e770ew.mp4

It will follow the rotation of the hips if I set the local settings from the config, but it would be very helpful if it would follow the rotation of the head.
I have it set up so that hand gestures change facial expressions, so it would be useful to check for that.
Yeah sorely needs the up and down rotation tracking of the head, it'll also cut down the need of having the mirror be massive to keep track of your body.
Is this addressed by the addition of the Face Mirror or are people interested in this for other reasons?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: One shortcoming of the current personal mirror implementation compared to the mod implementation is the lack of having multiple mirrors. While having the mirror rotate with you would not make up for this functionality missing, it would at least alleviate it somewhat.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Face mirrors are great, but I would prefer personal mirrors to follow head.
Because it would be useful if it also followed the movement by the SpaceMover.
I want to see my movements as well as my facial expressions.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}:  The "Hud" mirror is nice though having this same tracking space for the bigboy mirror would be really good to have like if you are dancing/presenting/talking etc. having a full-body reflection no matter where you look would be very practical to check your posture/bodylanguage or see if a hip tracker has decided to go hang out with the International Space Station
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Face mirror doesn't offer any control other than on/off
@{5ca74f3fb98a820b3ffec9cf|full_name}: Would be good for desktop streaming
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: In my case, Face mirror is what I want. Thank you.
